body: CONCRETE ROUTE REPAIR after comparing the live source pages. The root page now gives a credible capability overview and routes to seven executed workflows. The defect is specifically /scala/getting-started/: despite the slug and sidebar position, it is only the SurfaceAtlas lesson titled Inspect a source document. Preserve that good lesson but move it to /scala/inspect-source/. Reclaim /scala/getting-started/ as the real end-to-end quickstart: one-paragraph purpose and maturity boundary; source-checkout setup; the smallest public story-versus-recall program; exact captured output; the alignment figure; plain-language interpretation; then a six-workflow route map covering model, recall, align, support-aware summary, interview, and save/deliver. Do not duplicate every guide. Acceptance test: a reader arriving directly at the getting-started URL, without seeing the home page, can say within sixty seconds that the library represents stories and recalls, aligns recall partially to source plus named external states, preserves support/missingness, derives research summaries, scores interviews, and saves auditable artifacts; they also know arbitrary raw prose is not yet modeled end-to-end unattended. This is navigation/content architecture, not a new public API request.
